mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior 60 days reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS increase, or IC > 0.05 over the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (PAYEMS) below 5% for two consecutive months coincides with stronger than expected corporate hiring (GDPC1), creating a labor market contradiction that drives S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 5 and GDPC1 > 10,000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive when the labor contradiction is present.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in home sales (HOUST) exceeding 10% month-over-month suggests accelerating consumer confidence and preorders for capital goods, which elevates expected corporate profits and pushes S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.1 over the 60-day horizon despite the sales spike.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 50-week moving average for three consecutive months indicates supply-side softness, which raises the cost of capital and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when INDPRO remains below MA for >3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% for the first time in 90 days, the Fed typically cuts policy rates, lowering discount rates and supporting equity valuations, which drives S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5 and UNRATE trend down for 90 days
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is negative despite the unemployment threshold being crossed.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining payrolls (PAYEMS) below 200,000 suggest cooling labor demand, which raises real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive when PAYEMS remains below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 2% for three consecutive months triggers a preemptive rate hike by the Fed, which raises the cost of debt and reduces equity discount rates, pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: IC > 0.2 over the 20-day window despite the inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of industrial production (INDPRO) to GDP (implied via macro context) falls by 2% over a quarter, it signals supply-side contraction that outpaces demand, increasing the cost of capital and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when the contraction ratio is not met.
